title: Meera's Product Price Comparator
description:

A class PriceComparator implements Comparator« Product> and overrides the compare() method to return the difference of the second product's price minus the first product's price (this makes higher prices come first). The main function reads the inputs, creates a PriceComparator, calls sortProducts(), and prints each product's name and price. ### Input Format The first line of input consists of an integer N representing the number of products.
